transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because for over a year now, I've been trying to get someone to actually take me seriously. It's about my job. They started this new ticket rotation and these security audits, and... well, it's obvious they're being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps calling me in and showing me system logs, saying it's just the new policy for everyone, but I know what I'm seeing. I just need someone to listen and understand what's really going on.
Have you noticed these kinds of concerns happening outside of work as well, or is this something that's only been happening in your job environment?

No, it's really just happening at work. Outside of this whole issue with the ticket rotation and the audits, everything is fine. I mean, I still keep my house in order, pay all the bills, help my wife out with whatever she needs... my life is completely normal. 

And even at work, I handle the technical parts of my job just fine. Nobody is saying my actual work is sloppy or disorganized, because it isn't. It's just this specific agenda management has with the logs. So no, it's not happening anywhere else.
Have you ever felt that people outside of work, like friends, family, or neighbors, are acting against you or trying to harm you in some way?

No, not at all. My friends and family are great. My neighbors are just regular people, we wave and say hello. Nobody outside of the office is out to get me or anything like that. It's really just the management team at my job and this whole thing with the security audits. Outside of that, I don't have any problems with anybody.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others don’t seem to understand, even when you’ve tried to explain them clearly?

No, not really. I mean, the only thing is this situation at work. When I try to explain to my wife or my brother about the ticket rotation and how the system logs are being manipulated, they just... they don't get it. They say things like, "Oh, it's just corporate bureaucracy," or "Maybe they're just being strict with everyone." 

They don't understand the technical side of it, so they can't see how obvious it is that the data is being cherry-picked to make me look bad. But other than that specific issue? No. We agree on pretty much everything else. It's just this one thing that nobody seems to grasp.
Can you describe in detail what makes you believe the system logs are being manipulated specifically against you?

Well, it's been going on for over a year now. I've been trying to get someone, anyone, to take this seriously. The new ticket rotation they implemented... it's not random. And these new security audits, they're being used to build a paper trail specifically against me. 

Management keeps pulling me into meetings, showing me these system logs, and they just keep saying, "Oh, it's just policy, we're doing this for everyone." But I'm a support specialist, I know how these systems work. The logs they show me... they're selectively pulled. They only highlight the tickets where there was a delay, or where a complex issue took longer to resolve, and they conveniently leave out the dozens of tickets I close perfectly every single day. It's obvious to me that they are manipulating the data they present to make it look like I'm incompetent, even though I'm not.
Have you considered that management might be reviewing everyone's logs in the same way, and not singling you out, even though it feels that way to you?

I have thought about that. I mean, like I was just saying, that's exactly what management tells me. They keep showing me the logs and saying it's just policy, that they do it to everyone. 

But... well, that's actually why I'm here. For over a year now, I've been trying to get someone, anyone, to take this seriously. I know what I'm looking at. The new ticket rotation, the security audits—they aren't just routine checks for the whole team. They are being used to build a paper trail against me, specifically. So, yes, I've considered their explanation, but I know my job and I know the system, and their explanation just isn't the truth.

Despite management explaining that these audits and reviews are standard policy for everyone, and others not seeing the same pattern you do, do you still feel certain that this is specifically targeted at you without any doubt?

Yes. I am absolutely certain. I know I keep repeating myself, but that is exactly why I'm here. For over a year now, I've just been trying to get someone to actually take this seriously. Management keeps showing me those logs and telling me it's just standard policy, but... well, I know what I'm looking at. The way the new ticket rotation is set up, the specific security audits they keep running—it is all being used to build a paper trail against me. There is no doubt in my mind.
Have you ever taken any actions at work or elsewhere because of your belief that management is targeting you specifically?

Yes, I have. I mean, I have to protect myself. So lately, I've started avoiding certain network projects whenever I can get out of them. And when I do close out my tickets, I've been writing much longer, really detailed notes. I just have to document everything defensively now so they can't twist it around on me later. 

It's... well, it's definitely had an impact. Writing all that out takes time, which has slowed down my collaboration with the rest of the team. Plus, as you can probably guess, it's made my meetings with management pretty tense.
Even though management has told you these audits are standard policy and others don't see the same pattern you do, have you ever doubted your belief that this is specifically targeted at you?

No, I don't doubt it. I know we keep circling back to this, but like I said, that is the whole reason I'm here. For over a year now, I've just been trying to get someone to actually take this seriously. 

Management can keep showing me their logs and telling me it’s just policy until they're blue in the face. But I know how these systems work. I can see exactly how the new ticket rotation and those security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me. So no, I haven't doubted it, because the proof is right there in front of me.
Have you ever had similar beliefs in the past that others told you were incorrect, but you still felt certain were true, even when evidence was presented to the contrary?

No, I haven't. I mean... I've been working in IT for a long time, and I've never dealt with anything like this before. I've always had a solid track record at my past jobs and never really had any issues with management. So, no, there hasn't been any other time where I thought someone was doing something like this... because it just hasn't happened to me before. This is the first time.
How long have you felt absolutely certain that management has been specifically targeting you with these audits and ticket rotations?

Well, it's been going on since they rolled out the new hybrid schedule and made those changes to the after-hours ticket rotation. So, I'd say it's been about a year and two months now that I've been absolutely certain of it.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions like this in other areas of your life, not related to work, where you felt certain something was being done against you even when others didn’t agree?

No, nothing like that. It's really just this situation at work. My personal life is fine, you know? My neighbors are fine, my family... everything outside the office is completely normal. I've never felt like anyone else was out to get me or anything. It's strictly just what's happening with management and the ticket system at my job.
Can you explain what makes your belief about management targeting you different from what your coworkers might experience, and why you think you are the only one this is happening to?

Well, the difference is that my coworkers aren't getting audited the way I am. I'm here because for over a year now, I've been trying to get someone to take it seriously that the new ticket rotation and these security audits are being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me logs and telling me it's just standard policy, that it's random or automated, but I know it's not. I see the patterns in the tickets I'm assigned after hours. It's not happening to the other support specialists, just me. They're trying to force me out, and they're using the system to do it.
Have you ever, in your lifetime, had any other strong beliefs that others told you were not true, but you still felt absolutely certain about, even if there was no clear evidence to support them?

No, I haven't. Like I said, this is the only time something like this has happened. I don't go around making things up or imagining things, if that's what you're asking. I've never had any other... beliefs... that people told me weren't true. It's just this one situation at work because it's actually happening. There's nothing else in my life like that.
